name: Spell Facing
description: Defines facing requirements for spells (whether the target must be in front of the caster). In WoTLK+ this data comes from the FacingCasterFlags field of Spell.dbc, for Classic/TBC it is supplied by this table.

fields.name: Facing Caster Flags
fields.help: 1 = the target must be in front of the caster to cast the spell
